name: brain-signals
description: An answer-shape kit for scannable, verdict-first answers: the Brain Signals output style, the /explain family (explain, compare, map, zoom, why, tldr, diagram), a read-only cartographer subagent for architecture maps, /task for goal-locked execution, and a warn-only Stop hook that flags a turn ending in limbo (a prose question with no options, or background work with no wait line).
